entries.summary: Labeled single-line input with optional hint and error text.
entries.signature: export declare function TextField({ label, hint, error, type, id, className, disabled, ref, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid, ...props }: TextFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
usage: Import from @hyeonse/design-system/primitives and import components.css after tokens.css.
Native input attributes and ref are forwarded; className applies to the input element.
accessibility: The label targets the supplied id or a generated id.
Hint and error IDs are added to aria-describedby alongside a caller-supplied description; an error sets aria-invalid.
limitations: Single-line input only; the caller owns validation and error messages.

entries.summary: Labeled native checkbox with optional hint and error text.

usage: Import from @hyeonse/design-system/primitives and import components.css after tokens.css.
Native checkbox attributes, checked/defaultChecked, and ref are forwarded; className applies to the input element.
accessibility: The label targets the supplied id or a generated id.
Hint and error IDs are added to aria-describedby alongside a caller-supplied description; an error sets aria-invalid.
readOnly exposes aria-readonly and prevents click changes while retaining focus.
limitations: A checkbox has no native readOnly behavior; the component cancels clicks to preserve its value.
The caller owns validation and error messages.

entries.summary: Noninteractive span badge for a short status or category.

usage: Import from @hyeonse/design-system/primitives and import components.css after tokens.css.
Native span attributes and ref are forwarded; include text that communicates the status without color alone.
accessibility: Renders a span with its text content; tone alone does not announce meaning.
limitations: No interaction or live-region behavior is added.
